mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate the systemic effects of ophthalmic timolol (beta-blocker), increasing risk of severe hypertension, bradycardia, and hypertensive crisis, particularly if timolol is systemically absorbed.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative antidepressant or ophthalmologic agent; ensure adequate washout period if switching MAOIs; educate patient on signs of hypertensive crisis.
